validationRules.name: Action + object syntax
validationRules.description: Skill names must express one observable action and one durable object.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Use a single action + object construction.

validationRules.name: Canonical uniqueness
validationRules.description: Active canonical names may not duplicate another skill.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Merge the concepts or use an alias.

validationRules.name: Observable application
validationRules.description: A governed skill must describe observable application evidence.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Add a context, action and outcome signal.

validationRules.name: Source evidence
validationRules.description: Every governed skill must retain source evidence.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Attach an evidence excerpt and location.

validationRules.name: Valid taxonomy parent
validationRules.description: Every active group must resolve to an active parent.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Move the group to an active domain.

validationRules.name: Relationship graph integrity
validationRules.description: Active relationships require distinct active endpoints, rationale and a unique graph edge.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Select distinct active concepts, add rationale and remove duplicates.

validationRules.name: Mapping evidence
validationRules.description: Every mapping must contain evidence and rationale.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Add direct role evidence and rationale.

validationRules.name: Approved catalog grounding
validationRules.description: Mappings may only publish against approved skills.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Select an approved skill.

validationRules.name: Override accountability
validationRules.description: A manual score override must retain a reason.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Record an evidence-based reason.

validationRules.name: Feedback accountability
validationRules.description: Mapping feedback must retain an existing mapping, reviewer, reason and valid evidence completeness.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Complete the accountable feedback record.

validationRules.name: Role-profile skill integrity
validationRules.description: Active role profiles may only contain unique links to active governed skills.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Remove duplicate links and select active governed skills only.

validationRules.name: Role-profile source grounding
validationRules.description: Every approved role profile must resolve to an active governed job description.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Link the profile to its governed source job description.

validationRules.name: Controlled-tool skill integrity
validationRules.description: Active controlled tools may only contain unique links to active governed skills.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Retain unique links to active governed skills only.

validationRules.name: Mapping tool integrity
validationRules.description: Active mappings may only reference unique active controlled tools.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Select unique active controlled tools or remove obsolete references.

validationRules.name: Four-factor integrity
validationRules.description: The public metadata layer must contain four factors.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Restore four factors.

validationRules.name: Twelve-cluster integrity
validationRules.description: The navigation layer must contain twelve clusters.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Restore twelve clusters.

validationRules.name: Competency assignment integrity
validationRules.description: All 38 competencies must resolve to a cluster.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Assign every competency to a governed cluster.

validationRules.name: KFLA governance metadata
validationRules.description: Every factor, cluster and competency must retain source, licence, owner, version and review metadata.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Complete the governed provenance metadata before release.

validationRules.name: Four-level proficiency integrity
validationRules.description: The framework must retain four unique governed proficiency definitions.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Restore levels one through four and their behavioral indicators.

validationRules.name: Evidence source integrity
validationRules.description: Every evidence record must resolve to a governed source.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Select an existing governed source or create one before attaching evidence.

validationRules.name: Agent-tool registry integrity
validationRules.description: All eleven canonical agent tools must be uniquely identified, active and governed by complete callable contracts.
validationRules.suggestedCorrection: Restore complete schemas, permissions, data boundaries, runtime policies, error contracts, audit fields, versions and accountable owners.
